avatars.why: Padel draws players as avatars with its own code on its own page, which this check cannot drive; it moves to the avatar kit with the shared game page.
avatars.arrivalWhy: Padel plays its own travel reveal on its own page, not the shared page's arrival message.

party.shared: Padel is one player with an NPC partner against two NPCs. Party members share the club and each plays their own match.
party.late: Arrives in the club and starts their own match when they like.
party.dropped: Nothing changes for the others: every match is local to its player.
party.extra: No seats to run out of: each member plays their own match.
